previous_turn: Progress: completed 180 delayed-option calls, exact replay, negative adoption decision and actual judgment-to-set inconsistency.
mechanism: Original model emits question target, per-option clinical reason/yes-no-unknown, then native answer_choice. Program executes the same judgments: set of yes for multi, unique yes for single, native NOTA iff all substantive options no.
adaptation: Only logical answer aggregation is deterministic; clinical judgments and question interpretation remain original-model outputs. This is not a complete Faithful CoT reproduction or verified medical guideline execution.
controls: Fresh one-call direct re-answer with same original messages, model, temperature0 and max768 tokens. Structured model and program use the SAME generated judgments/response; same fallback policy. Raw model answer also scored separately to quantify fallback contribution.
fallback: Any unknown, unresolved single cardinality, absent nonempty native set or malformed response returns the actual original answer. Fallback applies equally to both structured branches; retain all18 denominator.
permissions: No new retrieval, answer-label retrieval, canonical49 catalog, paired reference or gold in inference. Only original item/options/context; output schema extended for intermediate judgments.
scope: Same frozen18 native-option R3 development questions, original M4/M5. Native53 and diagnosis680 remain overall goal; no independent generalization or all-method claim.
selection: Look for program improvement over the model using identical judgments, report repair/harm, compare baseline and matched direct. No posthoc threshold or per-disease routing search.
